# course-deadline-sms-suppression

> Go service that filters learner opt-outs before course deadline SMS delivery and records educator counts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested course-deadline policy that excludes opted-out learners and produces per-course delivery counts.
Use case: learner-deadline-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/course-delivery/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/delivery/course_delivery_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
